patch_description: The previous approach used multiple greedy orderings and 24 local-search passes, but it optimized KVPR only after placement. This version directly converts a target KVPR threshold `T` into an effective bin-packing size: `model_size + weight / T`. A placement is feasible at `T` when each GPU's effective size is at most 80 GB. Binary search over 32 threshold iterations produces a substantially better balanced initial placement. It uses best-fit and first-fit decreasing variants, then runs 36 strictly improving move/swap refinement passes. Refinement accepts improvements to maximum KVPR, with the sorted GPU-pressure vector as a secondary tie-breaker.
